title: Temporal difference learning adapts to incomplete coverage: an oracle inequality over subgraphs
abstract: arXiv:2411.09731v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Temporal difference (TD) and Monte Carlo (MC) are two fundamental principles for value function estimation in reinforcement learning. TD is asymptotically efficient for value estimation, whereas MC requires only adequate target visitation. We show that these advantages are automatically combined by ordinary TD in the tabular setting. We identify the subgraph Bellman variance, arising from bootstrapping within a subgraph and rollouts outside it, as a fundamental quantity connecting the MC and efficient TD benchmarks. With independent trajectories, we prove a non-asymptotic oracle inequality: the mean squared error of full TD is bounded by this variance divided by the sample size for every sufficiently covered subgraph containing the target, up to a higher-order remainder whose occupancy dependence is confined to that subgraph. No subgraph is supplied to the algorithm. TD thus adapts without selecting a subgraph or requiring glob

translated_title: 时序差分学习对不完全覆盖的自适应性：子图上的Oracle不等式
translated_abstract: 时序差分（TD）与蒙特卡洛（MC）是强化学习中价值函数估计的两个基本原则。TD在价值估计上是渐近高效的，而MC只需要充分的目标状态访问。我们证明，在表格情形下，普通的TD会自动地结合这两种方法的优势。我们识别出“子图Bellman方差”——它源于子图内部的自举（bootstrapping）与子图外部的rollout——作为连接MC基准与高效TD基准的一个基本量。在独立轨迹的条件下，我们证明了一个非渐近的oracle不等式：对于每一个包含目标状态且覆盖充分的子图，完整TD的均方误差都被该方差除以样本量所界定，最多相差一个高阶余项，且该余项对占用测度的依赖仅限于该子图之内。算法本身并不需要给定任何子图。因此，TD无需选择子图或要求全局覆盖即可实现自适应。
tldr: 本文证明在表格设定下，普通的时序差分（TD）学习能自动兼具蒙特卡洛方法“仅需目标状态充分访问”与TD自身“渐近高效”的双重优势，并以子图Bellman方差为核心量给出了一个非渐近oracle不等式：无需预先指定任何子图，TD即对每个覆盖充分的子图自适应地达到最优误差界。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in the tabular setting, ordinary temporal difference learning automatically combines Monte Carlo's mere target-visitability requirement with TD's asymptotic efficiency, establishing a non-asymptotic oracle inequality in terms of the subgraph Bellman variance—without supplying any subgraph—for every sufficiently covered subgraph containing the target.
